data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were $72.606m. During 2018 the Syndicate recorded an over-provision on prior years of $30.805m (a release), principally reflecting favourable claims development and an absence of major catastrophe activity on the years reinsured by the Syndicate. The 2017 hurricanes (Harvey, Irma and Maria) were identified separately and had been reserved at $36.2m and were the principal prior-year catastrophe items affecting the account.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary values are taken from the syndicate annual accounts denominated in USD. Opening reserves (72,606) taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding) 2017 comparative column; prior year movement (-30,805) taken from the Technical Provisions 'Over-provision in respect of prior claims' row. Values in source tables are presented in $000; converted here to millions. Exact reserve descriptive text was taken from the Technical Provisions table row. Confidence levels are high as figures are explicit in the notes. No gross/net ambiguity for the prior year movement since the table shows the gross 'Over-provision' line.
